statement: AMD guided Q2 2026 revenue to approximately $11.2 billion (+/- $300 million), above the $10.3 billion reported for Q1 2026.
why: Guidance above the just-reported quarter signals AMD expects continued sequential growth; management attributes the strength to AI infrastructure demand. Note this is total company revenue, not a data-center-GPU-only line.

impact.mechanism: Higher vendor revenue guidance implies more accelerator and server CPU shipments into AI datacenter buildouts.

confidence.basis: Content served from AMD's own investor-relations site, but the document states the exact detail-page URL is not confirmed and should be re-resolved before citing.
